_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with no live breaker, fear_greed mid-low, and flat momentum make HOLD the graded base-rate call inside the Anxiety band.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative offers no separate forward call beyond measured hold.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 30-45 and 30d momentum stays near 50 with no trend break through the next macro print
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed breaks under 25 with momentum under 35 (slide to Denial) or fear_greed sustains through 50 with ETF flows and momentum turning up (lift to Complacency)
